name: building-agents-with-strands
title_zh: 从零搭一个能调工具的 Agent
tagline_zh: 想给 FastAPI 或 Next.js 加个会调工具、能记会话的 Agent，却卡在框架选型和循环设计上？
tagline_en: Adding a tool-calling, session-aware agent to your FastAPI or Next.js app? Get Strands agent loops, MCP wiring.
desc_en: Use this skill when the user wants to build an AI agent, add agent capabilities to an existing app (FastAPI, Express, Next.js, or any Python/TypeScript service), or asks about agent frameworks, agent loops, tool use, MCP integration, multi-agent orchestration, agent memory or sessions, streaming agent responses, structured output, guardrails, or agent evaluation. Guides when to choose Strands Agen
why_zh: 不止给 API 文档，而是先判断你该不该上 Agent 框架，再落到 Strands 的循环、工具。
why_en: It first judges whether you need an agent framework at all, then lands on Strands loops, tools, memory and multi-agent.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Strands 这一个框架，用 LangGraph、CrewAI 或纯手写循环的它不替你选型。
limit_en: Strands-only: it won't pick LangGraph, CrewAI or a hand-rolled loop for you, and stops at code and design advice—no deploy, secrets or observability.
title_en: Build a tool-calling agent end to end with Strands
